preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 3 and 3000, inclusive.
Each station number xi and yi is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No station is directly connected to itself.

preconditions.expression: No pair of stations is connected by more than one passage.
preconditions.description: The subway scheme is a classic scheme with no duplicate passages.

preconditions.expression: The given description represents a classic subway scheme.
preconditions.description: The passages allow travel between any two stations in both directions.

postconditions.description: Each number represents the distance from the corresponding station to the ringroad.

postconditions.expression: The first n-1 numbers are non-zero.
postconditions.description: The stations not on the ringroad have a positive distance from the ringroad.
The ringroad station has a distance of zero from the ringroad.

postconditions.expression: The output is a permutation of the numbers 0 through n-1.
postconditions.description: Each station is uniquely assigned a distance from the ringroad, and the ringroad station is assigned distance 0.
